text: One stop shop for your beauty and dental needs :) Clean, professional, safe, with well-trained staff. Convenient parking next to the clinic.

I've been a long-time, regular patient here... I've tried many services, and the doctor is attentive, provides good advice, plans treatments, and I see clear results... Whether it's treating eczema, adult acne, laser treatments, Botox for the face/shoulder (to treat office syndrome), fillers, peeling for brightening, localized fat reduction, cool treatments, and more... Dr. Best also has a wide variety of high-quality products to take home and use alongside treatments at reasonable prices.

The clinic staff, Khun Waew and Khun Fon, are also very lovely. They provide attentive and understanding service.

Previously, I only went to the clinic for treatments I couldn't manage myself, like Botox and fillers, and then spent my money at department store counters instead, buying creams and cosmetics... Now I've changed. If I want to address a problem, I ask the doctor, and the results are better, at a price comparable to counter brands...

Highly recommend! ✌

text: I usually never write reviews, but I tried the Cool Crystal Fat Freezing Program with Dr. Best at The Unplus Skin Clinic and it was amazing! I saw real results. I had my first session in May and my second in September. My waist circumference decreased by 18 centimeters! My stomach has really shrunk. It's noticeable that my pants fit smaller now. This is the slimmest I've been in ten years since having children. I look more shapely in dresses, and many people have commented on how much thinner I look. Dr. Best is incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and answers all my questions. She provides excellent advice and the results are exactly as she predicted. The staff are also very friendly and attentive. The clinic is clean, and the equipment is FDA-approved. I feel so confident after the treatment! I'm already planning my third and fourth sessions! 😊👏👍
